# 🍌 Banana MC

> Modern • Smooth • Cinematic • Optimized  
> Carefully crafted Fabric client modpack for the best visual & gameplay experience.

ㅤㅤ![And animations! №1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddeedd8b20a45a7ea71e6542982de4c0a8c073d3.gif)
![And more animations! №2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18e60f18d0adcfe15abc069febf5018d2745361f.gif) ![Cool Water.gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5417b4cf111cf8e840add2a5ae9f93a8efac442.gif) ![Attack!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efd6ceda21410eccf1d99720407dbcbea06c6f47.gif)

---

Banana MC is a modern Fabric modpack that combines smooth performance, cinematic animations, and immersive visuals.
It brings together powerful optimization mods with enhanced UI, dynamic lighting, shaders, and quality-of-life improvements.
Perfect for survival, content creation, and delivering beautiful gameplay even on low to mid-range PCs. 🍌

## 🎯 Goal of the Pack

Banana MC focuses on:
- Smoothness  
- Beautiful visuals
- Clean and minimal interface  

## ✨ Features

### 🎥 Cinematic Animations
- Fresh player animations  
- Better third person camera  
- Enhanced attack indicator  
- Immersive movement & physics  
- Smooth swaps & scrolling  

### 🌧️ Immersion & Atmosphere
- Dynamic weather & storms  
- Realistic sounds & footsteps  
- Smooth skies & improved skybox  
- Particle interactions & effects  
- Ambient rain improvements  

### ⚡ Performance Optimized
- Sodium + Lithium + FerriteCore  
- Entity & particle culling  
- ImmediatelyFast & Exordium  
- Async resource loading  
- Clean F3 & optimized debugging  

### 🖥️ UI & Quality of Life
- Clean & compact chat  
- Better HUD elements  
- Status effect bars  
- Shulker tooltips  
- Inventory particles  
- Map in slot  
- Zoom & dynamic lights

## 🔧 Installation

### 📥 Modrinth App
<details>
<summary>Click to expand</summary>

1. Open **Modrinth App**
2. Click **Add instance**
3. Search for **Banana MC**
4. Click **Install**
5. Play!

</details>

### 🧩 Prism Launcher
<details>
<summary>Click to expand</summary>

1. Open **Prism Launcher** or **MultiMC**
2. Click **Add Instance**
3. Click **Modrinth**
4. Search for **Banana MC**
5. Play!

</details>
